title: Platformer Movement
description: Create a responsive 2D platformer character with horizontal running, jumping, one-way platform drop-through, and synchronized animations.

blocks.content: The [Platformer Controller](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerController) node gives your character side-scrolling movement, ground detection, jumping, and one-way platform drop-through in a single node. Pair it with [Platformer Animator](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerAnimator) to switch between idle, run, jump, and fall clips and flip the sprite automatically.

items.title: Walk & Jump
items.desc: Responsive horizontal speed and vertical jump impulse with ground checks.

items.title: One-Way Drop
items.desc: Hold **Down** and press **Jump** on tagged platforms to drop through them.

items.title: Event Hooks
items.desc: Trigger sound effects or particles from **onJump**, **onLand**, and **onDrop** pins.

blocks.content: Before building the script, configure your player [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs) and ground in the scene.

rows: Attach both to the player entity and create animation clips such as **idle**, **run**, **jump**, and **fall**.
Attach to the player entity with **Motion Mode** set to **Platformer (Side-Scroll)** and **Gravity Scale** set between **1.5** and **2.5**.
Attach a **Solid (Physics)** collider to the player (increase **Corner Radius (Capsule)** so the feet do not snag on tile seams) and to your floor or [Tilemap](components/renderers/tilemap).
Attach to the player entity to run the platformer visual script.

blocks.content: Wire the controller and animator nodes inside your player script.

items: Open your player script in the [visual scripting](visual_scripting/graph_concepts) editor and add an [On Tick](node_library/game_lifecycle#node-eventTick) node.

Add a [Platformer Controller](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerController) node and a [Platformer Animator](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerAnimator) node from [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool).
Connect **execOut** on **On Tick** to **execIn** on **Platformer Controller**, then connect **execOut** on **Platformer Controller** to **execIn** on **Platformer Animator**.
Connect the **movementState** and **facingDirection** data outputs from **Platformer Controller** to the matching inputs on **Platformer Animator**.
Select **Platformer Animator** and enter your clip names in **idleClips**, **runClips**, **jumpClips**, and **fallClips** inside the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).
Attach the script to your player entity and click **Play** in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport) to test running and jumping with **A**, **D**, and **Space**.

blocks.content: Tune these inputs on **Platformer Controller** and **Platformer Animator** to match the feel of your game.

rows: Horizontal movement speed in pixels per second.
Upward velocity applied when jumping. Pair with a higher **Gravity Scale** on **Physics Body** for snappy jumps.
Keyboard keys used for moving left, moving right, jumping, and crouching or dropping.
Entity tag that identifies one-way platforms the player can drop through when pressing **keyDown** and **keyJump**.
Downward pixel offset applied when dropping through a one-way platform.
On **Platformer Animator**, automatically mirrors the sprite horizontally when **facingDirection** is **left**.

blocks.content: Expand the base platformer setup with camera tracking, audio feedback, or melee combat.

rows: Connect an [On Scene Start](node_library/game_lifecycle#node-eventSceneStart) node to [Camera Follow](node_library/game_renderer#node-actionCameraFollow) and set **targetEntity** to your player's ID.
Connect the **onJump** and **onLand** execution pins on **Platformer Controller** to [Play Audio](node_library/system_utilities#node-playAudio) nodes.

Chain [Platformer Combat](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerCombat) after **Platformer Controller** and wire **facingDirection** and **isGrounded** into it. See [Triggers & Hitboxes](behaviour/physics_and_collision/triggers_and_hitboxes).
Character cannot jump even though **Space** is pressed
Verify that the floor has a **Solid (Physics)** collider so **isGrounded** becomes **true** when the player lands.
Character gets stuck on flat tilemap seams while walking
Select the player's **Solid (Physics)** collider in **Multi-Collider** and increase **Corner Radius (Capsule)** to **4** or higher.
Increase **Gravity Scale** on the player's **Physics Body** to **2.0** or **2.5** and raise **jumpForce** on **Platformer Controller** to compensate.
